d: An innocent man isn't worried about a new murder charge against him, but he is afraid that once the police process his fingerprints, they will learn that he is a fugitive from a 25-year-old homicide investigation.
When five terrorists whose plan to pass through a security checkpoint at a boating dock fails, they flee taking on several hostages including Inspector Steve Keller.
A troubled teen from a broken home is suspected of shooting a friend's stepfather.
A killer ends up working with a witness to their crime.
Lieutenant Michael Stone and Inspector Steven Keller investigate the murder of women. The murderer was wearing an officer's uniform of the United States Air Force.
Mike's former partner returns to San Francisco, but not because of any longing for the good old days. He is back in town to kill the hired gunman who murdered his son years before.
A single .25 caliber pistol affects many lives in a single weekend.
A retired cobbler takes the rap for a shooting to protect the real killer, the grandson of his best friend.
The CSI-team is brought in to solve the case of a recently murdered student.
The CSI team is called in to investigate a robbery-homicide at a themed wedding.
CCTV footage seems to make a murder in a casino an open and shut case.
A Hispanic police officer is fed up with his old neighborhood being turned into a narcotics haven by a pusher named Perez.
A skeleton discovered on Alcatraz is that of a convict who supposedly escaped in the 1950s.
After Steve is injured in a fray with a gangster, Mike is demoted to walking a beat for insubordinately insisting on taking revenge.
Kane maneuvers to get a shot at the Ghost – but the FBI has taken notice of Kane’s activities and they want him stopped.
Kane’s team sacrifices everything to get him close enough to get his shot at the Ghost…
Elijah Kane and his team are on the case of a double homicide just as a dirty cop gets involved with Russian drug lord. New cop, Sarah Montgomery is added to the team.
Elijah Kane gets pressure from Chief Graves  to put an end to a Russian drug ring, while newbie cop Sarah proves herself on the street.
